name: Mount Holly Truck Manufacturing Plant - Mount Holly NC

fieldNotes.location: Geocode (GEOMETRIC_CENTER, moved 2149m) landed inside the campus. Confirmed Freightliner Mount Holly M2/SD medium-duty truck plant via DTNA career-locations page and Waze (1803 N Main St). Two-building campus: SW main assembly building plus a large NE rail-served building, joined by an internal road.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Campus is a controlled industrial site; the access road enters from the residential road network to the NE. The actual gate sits back behind a wooded buffer and could not be reached in Street View (only residential roads have panos, all from 2023-04). Controlled-access industrial campus, so truckGate set true with the gate box placed at the access-road head.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth confirmed; gate area not reachable in Street View. Defaulted guardShack false / remoteGs true - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed against the NW and S/SE faces of the SW main building; estimate 25-50 doors, flagged uncertain (some faces obscured).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer drop yard between the two buildings with many rows of dropped trailers - clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate count (~130) from drop-yard and dock imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail line runs alongside the NE building.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two large building clusters (SW assembly building, NE rail-served building) on one connected campus.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts docks on the NW/S faces are physically separate from the NE rail-served building and the SE laydown/yard flow.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Mount Holly is a Charlotte-metro suburb; the campus is ringed by dense residential subdivisions - judged Urban.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Could not count lanes at the gate (not reachable in Street View) - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Quarry/construction activity SE of the NE building may serve staging but is not a clear pre-gate truck apron - left false.
